ask: can u make a poll for this so we can each pick a room + slot
sentence: A two-part poll where each person can pick any of two library rooms and any of four weekly time slots, with live vote counts, voter faces and a leading choice shown.
use_when: A group needs to choose a study room and a time slot together
Everyone should be able to pick several options that work for them
You want to see which room and slot are winning before deciding
Planning one or two study sessions with a short fixed list of choices
dont_use_when: The options are open-ended and people need to add their own choices
You need a single-choice vote where each person picks only one option
You need to book an exact calendar time or split tasks between people
